profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a programmer who loves building things.

I have developed components and applications in Python, Go, Java, and JavaScript.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Observability team at Lyft:
- Maintained / operated on a federated ElasticSearch cluster for logging
  - Fixed indexing, search / retrieval issues, etc
- Built out an alerting service backed by an in-house metrics TSDB
- Distributed tracing
- Worked on metrics collection, aggregation, etc, pipelines

positions.title: Freelance Web Designer / Developer
positions.description:
A sole proprietorship I created to provide website services.

In April of 2014 I collaborated with Jobvite to create Logitech's career site portal.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Jobvite Hire provides companies and recruitment agencies with software to track and maintain candidates and requisitions. I dealt specifically with the Jobvite 'Career Site', which are customer webpages that list jobs, with job descriptions and application pages. Additionally, I provided information on how to integrate and display requisition information on customers websites (via our API, Career Sites embedded within iFrames, etc).

My job duties included everything from customizing customers' career sites, troubleshooting general Jobvite issues, filing bugs, and consulting with customers on their Jobvite careers page integrations. Customer career site customizations included custom scripts and unique solutions to fit customers' needs.
